subject: Your Codex plugins for creators post
text:
Hi,

Just read Fuxuan's best Codex plugins for creators post. The "skip it if" line under each pick is really useful, and it's nice to see Remotion and HyperFrames next to the big names.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins. ChatCut isn't on it yet and I'd be happy to add the ChatCut plugin as a free listing, with a README badge you can use if you like. If you ever update the post, our State of Codex Plugins research is free to cite with a credit link: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: One more for your MCP registries page
text:
Hi,

Your MCP registries page is a nice short list, and I like that each one says how it takes a new server.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins that also lists MCP servers. Listing is free, makers just email the repo or endpoint. Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Where to launch: plugin directories

text:
